notes: Calendar year 2023 contains TWO CHSL Tier I (CBE) examinations: (a) CHSL 2022-23 cycle: result91.com/Shiksha document exam days 09, 10, 13 and 16-Mar-2023 (completeness of this day list NOT verified - other March days may have been exam days; per-day shift counts not established - null); (b) CHSL 2023-24 cycle: conducted on 02, 03, 04, 07, 08, 09, 10, 11, 14 and 17-Aug-2023 (10 exam days) with 4 shifts per day = 40 expected shifts, per Adda247's CHSL PYQ page which hosts 4 distinct CBE exam-screen export PDFs (one per shift) for each of the 10 dates (object ids 09181126-09181238). CONFLICT: Shiksha's per-day article TOC lists 'August 5' as an exam day (absent from Adda247's PDF map); Adda247's direct per-shift PDFs are the stronger evidence and are used here, with the conflict flagged. Verified files in this repository: 02-Aug Shifts 1-4 and 03-Aug Shifts 1 and 4 (6 of 40).
